_readme: Optional. Only list photographs that need something better than the default.
Keys are the photo id: the filename without its extension (DSC01757.JPG -> DSC01757).
caption  short editorial line under the frame (default: none — the frame stands alone)
alt      what is actually in the frame, for screen readers. Please write these.
note     a second line, shown only in the photograph viewer
weight   lead (a full plate) | major (opens a row) | minor (default)
order    a seat number counting from 1; unpinned frames flow around it by capture time
takenAt  2026-08-29T14:20, for a frame whose file lost its EXIF (camera wall clock)
featured true opens the journal with this photograph (the first one wins)
hidden   true keeps the file in the repo but off the page
A caption written against an old filename follows the photograph when a
higher-resolution version replaces it. See /admin/photos for what needs work.

DSC01757.alt: A covered hotel entrance passage with dark timber beams and tall potted palms, a brass luggage cart at the left and daylight falling across the tiled floor.

DSC01758.alt: A tall palm in a grey planter above a bed of low leafy planting, on a pale stone floor, with a lit display window behind and daylight coming from an opening above.

DSC01775.alt: People serving themselves at a breakfast buffet — pastries and fruit on wooden boards, serving tongs, a tall dark urn behind, a backpack set down on the floor.

IMG_7879.alt: A ballroom set with round banquet tables and cream chairs, one projection screen lit against a dark stage curtain, a few people already seated at the far side.
IMG_7879.note: Twenty tables, set for twenty conversations.

DSC01762.alt: A hexagonal light fitting of lit tubes, its mirrored interior repeating the shape inward, set against a ceiling of dark vertical slats.

IMG_7878.alt: A printed floor plan pinned to a wall, showing twenty numbered round tables in front of a stage, with the AV positions marked.

IMG_7877.alt: A printed board headed “Table Themes”, listing twenty numbered tables against a faculty name and a discussion topic.
IMG_7877.note: The full list is transcribed further down this page.

DSC01781.caption: “Come for the learning. Stay for the people.”
DSC01781.alt: A presenter in white stands on a low stage beside a large screen reading “Welcome to LEADderm — Come for the learning. Stay for the people.”, under a coffered ceiling, a chandelier at the top left.
DSC01781.note: The welcome slide, in the meeting’s own words.

IMG_7885.caption: The room settles for the welcome.
IMG_7885.alt: A person stands on a low stage beside a projection screen reading “Welcome to LEADderm”, seen over the heads of seated attendees.

IMG_7886.caption: A bow tie and a page of notes.
IMG_7886.alt: A bearded man in a mustard jacket and a patterned bow tie, holding notes, in front of a dark red stage curtain.

IMG_7884.alt: A wide view across banquet tables toward the lit screen, a coffee cup and a pen on the table in the foreground and a table card at the right.

DSC01774.alt: Half a dozen people standing and talking around a cloth-draped high table in a hotel foyer, a chandelier overhead and a second table in the foreground.

DSC01778.alt: A board on an easel printed with a thought bubble reading “One thing that keeps me grounded is…”, five sticky notes added around it, and someone walking past behind.
DSC01778.note: The 2026 meeting is themed Strong Ground.

DSC01783.alt: A printed card standing on a table: “Leadership isn’t always quiet. Sometimes the best ideas make a little noise. Keep challenging assumptions. Keep asking questions. Keep sparking conversations. Keep making an impact. Enjoy the Pop Rocks… and make some noise!” A second card behind it reads Entrepreneurship.

DSC01784.alt: A man in a dark suit and glasses stands alone at the centre of a low stage, a lavalier microphone on his shirt, between two warm uplights on the dark curtain, seen over the heads of the audience.
DSC01784.caption: Alone at the centre of the stage.

DSC01790.alt: An arm’s-length selfie of four men in front of a projection screen showing a QR code and “Download the LEADderm mobile app”, all smiling, the frame soft with motion.

DSC01793.caption: Arms around each other, in front of the QR code.
DSC01793.alt: Four men stand in a row with arms around each other’s shoulders in front of a projection screen showing a large QR code and “Download the LEADderm mobile app — www.leadderm.org/mobile”, the two at the ends giving a thumbs-up and a shaka.
DSC01793.note: Take two, twenty-five seconds after the selfie.

DSC01801.alt: Three men pose side by side in a bright, daylit lounge, arms around each other’s backs, two framed botanical prints on the wall behind them and a patterned carpet underfoot.
DSC01801.caption: Between sessions, in the daylight.

DSC01824.caption: Under the string lights.
DSC01824.alt: Two men pose arm in arm at an outdoor evening gathering, one pointing a thumb at the other, string lights and an umbrella against a deep blue dusk sky, a wine glass on the cloth-draped table behind.

DSC01827.alt: A night-time arm’s-length photograph of three people seated close together on white folding chairs, strings of warm bulbs crossing the darkening sky above them, palms silhouetted behind.
DSC01827.caption: Still out on the chairs.

DSC01838.alt: Two people pose side by side in front of a dark curtain washed with purple light, both wearing lanyards, one giving a thumbs-up.
DSC01838.caption: Thumbs up in front of the curtain.

DSC01841.alt: A woman in a periwinkle-blue coat over a black dress laughs with her hands clasped, standing on a carpeted stage in front of a black drape with a band of violet light.
DSC01841.caption: Caught laughing.

DSC01846.alt: An arm’s-length group photograph of four people shoulder to shoulder in front of a dark drape, all smiling, name badges on their lanyards.
DSC01846.caption: Four of them, at arm’s length.

DSC01849.alt: Photographed from low in the room, a woman in a white blazer dress stands on the empty stage riser with both arms spread wide, a black drape lit purple behind her.
DSC01849.caption: Arms wide, on the empty stage.

DSC01853.alt: A woman in a white blazer dress and a taller man in an olive polo shirt stand together on the stage riser, arms around each other’s backs, purple uplights spaced along the drape behind.
DSC01853.caption: Two on the riser.

DSC01855.alt: Four people stand arm in arm on the stage riser in front of the dark drape, one giving a thumbs-up, two bags set down on the platform edge beside them.
DSC01855.caption: Bags down, one more photograph.

DSC01862.caption: Heart-led entrepreneurship, table ten.
DSC01862.alt: A woman smiles at the camera holding a printed table card reading “Dr. Manju Dawkins — Heart-led Entrepreneurship”, the projection screen glowing behind her.
DSC01862.note: One of the twenty table themes, held up for the record.

DSC01868.caption: Back in the lobby, bag on the sofa.
DSC01868.alt: Two people smile at the camera in the hotel lobby — one crouched with a thumbs-up, one seated on a velvet sofa with a straw tote bag beside her — the plant-filled shelves and lamps of the lounge glowing behind them.

IMG_7900.alt: A woman in a black top and wide black trousers stands mid-sentence on the stage, both hands open at her sides, a warm streak of light down the dark curtain behind her.
IMG_7900.caption: Both palms open, mid-sentence.

IMG_7925.alt: A bald man with glasses, in a navy blazer and patterned tie, gestures with a raised open hand on stage, the tops of banquet chairs soft in the foreground.
IMG_7925.caption: An open hand, making a point.

IMG_7934.alt: A man in a light blue shirt and pale trousers speaks on stage, both hands blurred mid-gesture, dark curtain folds behind him.
IMG_7934.caption: Crossing the stage, mid-sentence.

IMG_7940.alt: A bald man with glasses speaks into a handheld microphone on the low stage, his free hand raised, warm light raking the dark curtain.
IMG_7940.caption: On the microphone.

IMG_7943.alt: A woman in a blue-and-white floral dress stands on the stage riser holding a presentation clicker, a coppery band of light in the dark curtain behind her and a banquet chair in the foreground.
IMG_7943.caption: A clicker in one hand.

IMG_7948.alt: A man in a blue suit and dark red tie stands on stage with both hands open at his sides, seen past the back of a head in the row in front.
IMG_7948.caption: Hands open, over the row in front.

IMG_8001.alt: A woman with long blonde hair, in a black top with white trim, looks off-frame with a hand raised to her chest, the dark curtain behind her washed purple.
IMG_8001.caption: Looking off, hands at her chest.

IMG_8002.alt: A woman with long blonde hair stands with hands clasped, smiling toward the side of the room, a lavalier microphone at her neckline and purple light in the curtain folds.
IMG_8002.caption: Hands clasped, turned to the room.

CC13772F-BFE0-4388-86CD-08DE8C40C09C.alt: A night-time selfie of two men giving thumbs-up under strings of warm bulbs, hedges and empty chairs in the darkness behind them.
CC13772F-BFE0-4388-86CD-08DE8C40C09C.caption: Thumbs up, after dark.

IMG_7951.caption: Dinner on the lawn.
IMG_7951.alt: A round table laid with white linen and plated dinners, people eating around it, and beyond them standing tables, a clipped hedge, palms and pines against a pale dusk sky, with a string of bulbs running overhead.

IMG_7952.alt: A white plate seen from above: a glazed dark braised portion topped with halved dark fruit, a fennel and radish salad with capers, a charred half lemon and a crisp-skinned fish fillet, with a tumbler and folded napkin soft in the background.
IMG_7952.caption: What arrived on the plate.

IMG_7953.alt: A wide view of the outdoor dinner: round tables set on a lawn with thirty or more people seated and talking, a clipped hedge behind them and the hotel rising above the trees against a clear evening sky.
IMG_7953.caption: Everyone out on the lawn, the hotel behind.

IMG_7954.alt: The dinner seen past the back of someone’s head from a seat at the table, plates and a wine glass in the foreground, more tables and the hedge beyond.
IMG_7954.caption: From a seat at the table.

IMG_7973.alt: A folding wooden screen standing beside a large potted fig in a quiet corridor, on a pale checked carpet.
IMG_7973.caption: A folding screen and a fig tree, on the way back.

IMG_7974.caption: The sign, at the end of the night.
IMG_7974.alt: A dark signage panel with raised gold lettering reading “Pendry — Newport Beach”, mounted on a wall of vertical fluted metal.

IMG_7977.caption: The lounge with nobody in it.
IMG_7977.alt: An empty hotel lounge at night: velvet sofas and cane chairs, black lantern pendants overhead, a model boat in a lit display case and a red armchair by the glass doors.

IMG_7982.caption: Breakfast, the second morning.
IMG_7982.alt: A plate seen from above with scrambled eggs, cured fish, pickled onion and capers, a wedge of terrine, and avocado toast with radish and sprouts, a parfait glass out of focus behind it.

IMG_7984.alt: A bearded man in a blue-grey blazer speaks into a handheld microphone in front of a dark curtain, a badge on a lanyard at his chest, seen past the heads of two people seated in front.
IMG_7984.caption: Lanyard still on, microphone in hand.

IMG_7985.caption: Burnout, by its other name.
IMG_7985.alt: A projection screen showing a dark slide headed “Burnout aka Moral Injury”, listing emotional exhaustion, depersonalization and low personal accomplishment, and what it is associated with. A silhouetted head faces the screen from the foreground.

IMG_7986.caption: The drivers. And a goat.
IMG_7986.alt: A slide headed “Dermatology Burnout Drivers” listing documentation and EHR time, administrative tasks, productivity demands and loss of autonomy, beside a photograph of a person holding a plank pose with a small goat standing on their back.

IMG_7987.caption: Ikigai, in four circles.
IMG_7987.alt: A slide showing four overlapping circles — what you love, what you are good at, what the world needs, what you can be paid for — meeting at the word “Ikigai” in the centre.

IMG_7988.caption: Two weeks of tracking what drains you.
IMG_7988.alt: A slide headed “Energy Audit”: track daily activities for one to two weeks and sort them into energizing, neutral and draining, then delegate, automate or remove what drains.

IMG_7989.caption: The eulogy exercise.
IMG_7989.alt: A slide headed “Eulogy Exercise” — imagine how you will be remembered, to bring clarity to current priorities — under a stepped ceiling and a tiered chandelier.

IMG_7991.caption: Baseline, knock, recovery.
IMG_7991.alt: A slide of four stacked colour bars headed “Know your tendencies”: baseline satisfaction, how far feedback knocks you off it, and how long recovery takes. It ends: know yourself, remember others are different.

DSC01829.caption: Turned toward the front, table cards still out.
DSC01829.alt: Three people seated in profile at a round banquet table, watching something off to the left, with printed table cards propped on the linen and rows of empty chair backs across the foreground.

IMG_7996.alt: A projection screen asking “Do you want to get to know yourself better?”, introducing the Enneagram with a nine-pointed diagram, a QR code and a book cover, above rows of empty banquet chairs.
IMG_7996.caption: “Do you want to get to know yourself better?”

IMG_7997.caption: Nine styles, and the gift in each.
IMG_7997.alt: A slide headed “Nine styles of leadership, by Enneagram type”, pairing each type’s stereotype with its true gift, beside a nine-pointed diagram and a QR code.

IMG_7998.caption: “Clear is kind.”
IMG_7998.alt: A slide headed “Lecture Takeaways”: start small, clear is kind — directness is the highest form of professional empathy — ground feedback in what is observable, and don’t work harder on someone’s growth than they do.

IMG_7999.caption: Capability, perspective, wisdom.
IMG_7999.alt: A slide headed “How Success Evolves”, with a seedling, a tree and a fruiting tree above three columns — early career, mid career, later career — running from capability and expertise through perspective and stewardship to wisdom, legacy and developing others.
